messages:
maria: quick FYInoticed a tiny double charge in canary. streaming session got preempted, routed to fallback, toolcall retried; customer billed twice for a 3-4 token window.
jake: any ids/logs?
maria: session=sess_cf12, toolcall=tc_9e3. Router: PREEMPT -> HANDOFF -> TOOLCALL_RETRY within ~150ms.
kevin: ledger shows two provisional entries that both moved to confirmed. dedupe missed because prefix hashes differed.
anya: our dedupe uses (session, prefix_hash). split boundaries break that.
kevin: idea: include token range [start,end] in router events and check range overlap in reconciler instead of strict hash equality.
jake: short-term: stop auto-confirm for provisionals within 500ms of handoff for same session. cheap and fast.
maria: agree. also add alert + dashboard panel for "split provisional duplicates" by route pair.
kevin: i'll draft a short RFC for overlap-dedupe and a minimal schema change for `prefix_range`.
jake: i'll implement billing-bot timeout and the alert.
maria: i'll attach trace and ping support to fix invoice.
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_x01 amount_tokens=3 session=sess_cf12 source=canary-1
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_x02 amount_tokens=4 session=sess_cf12 source=fallback-std
